**Done — the one-time objectui stock pass is complete and verified. Closing as completed.**

Executed by a dispatched classification agent under this claim; verified against GitHub, not the agent's report: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectui label:target:v17 is:open` returns **exactly 11**, matching the reported set; spot-checked label integrity on applied cards (merged writes — pre-existing `pm:queue` / `pm:dispatched` / `bug` / `documentation` labels all intact); each applied card carries its one-line audit comment.

## Boarded (11 of 98 reviewed — 52 `pm:queue` + 46 `finding`, every body read)

| # | class | one line |
|---|---|---|
| objectui#3892 | ① | `objectui init` scaffolds `@object-ui/* ^2.0.0` against 17.3.0 platform packages — first-command failure |
| objectui#3871 | ① | `toPredicateInput` re-wraps normalised `${…}` templates → every documented action predicate evaluates `true` (7 call sites) |
| objectui#3862 | ① | `disabled: ''` / `null` permanently disables any control (`!== undefined` gate) |
| objectui#3850 | ① | `{dialect, source: ''}` — exactly what `objectstack build` emits for an empty predicate — permanently greys the button |
| objectui#3569 | ① | sub-table folds `datetime`/`time` into a date control; saving discards the time component — data loss |
| objectui#3129 | ① | ListView timeline ignores declared `timeline.startDateField`; all records bucket under "No date" |
| objectui#3055 | ① | position/team/department approvers see no decision buttons (`canDecide` reads `position:xxx` literals client-side) |
| objectui#3899 | ② | published `packages/layout` declares `sideEffects: false` while registration is a load-time side effect — conforming bundlers drop it |
| objectui#3891 | ④ | `objectui doctor` false-positives on every Tailwind 4 project and misses the real check |
| objectui#3883 | ④ | `troubleshooting.md`'s styling fix measured not to fix what it claims |
| objectui#3904 | ④ | documented layout component typed into the shipped Playground renders an error panel |

**Rate: 11.2%** (calibration: objectstack's pass ran ~15%; a UI-heavy backlog qualifying lower is expected).

## Borderline, left off — maintainer veto window (top candidates)

1. **objectui#3318** — 29/46 field widgets never emit `aria-invalid`; boarded **iff a11y is a GA gate** (multi-week batch, pre-existing, ratcheted).
2. **objectui#2890** — the whole card is a 6-PR migration project (off), but its buried sub-item — `computeAggregation` implements 5 of 11 declared `ColumnSummary` functions, rest render an empty footer — is a clean ② that could be split out and boarded alone.
3. **objectui#2628 / #2627** — first-hour paths: 3–6s unindicated white screen post-registration; ~10s silent gap + history-clearing race after AI blueprint approval.
4. objectui#2514 (advertised `passkeys`/`magicLink` consumed by nothing — the lie is at least declared in a framework-side exempt reason) and objectui#2762-P0-2 (one-click irreversible approve/reject, no confirm).

Full ranked list with reasons is in the PM session record; any of these can be boarded by a one-word veto.

## Anomalies observed, not fixed (for the objectui seat / triage)

- **Nine `pm:queue` cards self-describe as observation-class findings** in their own bodies (#3879 #3866 #3846 #3845 #3840 #3857 #3809 #3815 #3586) — "on the queue" cannot currently be read off the label alone.
- **Labels are not cleared on close**: #3562 and #3610 closed while still carrying `pm:queue`/`pm:dispatched`.
- #3789 carries `pm:queue` + `pm:blocked` with a failed measurement gate recorded in its own header — queued but undispatched-able.
- #3528/#3512 both record that filing-time dedup was impossible (shared identity rate-limited) — duplicate risk in that window.

## Standing posture from here

This was the **single** stock pass. Both repos are now incremental-only — never full-rescan. The standing producer for objectui's board is the objectui whole-repo seat per #6903 (SKILL amendment in flight as PR #6911).
